newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor seeks to develop hotels in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Accor seeks to develop hotels in Spain.

text.p: French hotel group Accor is eager to develop two-star hotels in Spain and is in discussions to form a joint venture with the Spanish hotel chain NH, a spokeswoman for Accor said on Thursday.
NH is 64 percent controlled by Cofir, a Spanish conglomerate which has shifted its focus to its core businesses.
The Accor spokeswoman said Accor and NH signed a preliminary agreement in November to study forming a venture to develop two-star hotels under the Ibis insignia.
They will also study the possibility of a more downmarket venture under the Formula 1 brand, she said.
"We have a very small presence in the Spanish market and we want to expand it," she said. "We have a strong interest in developing a two-star chain there."
Accor and NH are expected to deliver proposals for the project by the end of January.
Cofir's new focus was unveiled last month after Carlo De Benedetti sold his 48 percent stake in the group to mostly British-based institutions.
